headline: Continental Controls rights issue at ₹10
summary: Continental Controls Ltd announced a rights issue of 1.96 crore shares at ₹10 per share to raise ₹19.66 crore. Record date is October 14, 2026.

headline: Nasscom addresses US green card suspension
summary: Nasscom clarifies that immigration and skilled talent mobility are distinct issues, noting Indian tech firms have reduced H-1B dependence.

headline: Oseaspre to seek EGM approval for capital hike
summary: Oseaspre Consultants plans an EGM on October 30, 2026, to approve raising authorised capital to ₹70 lakh and issuing shares on a preferential basis.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: TCS, NCC, Lupin, Jaykay in focus
summary: TCS flags margin pressure despite AI growth; NCC wins ₹1,286 Cr order but slips. Lupin gains FDA approval while Jaykay drops 8.8% on subsidiary funding news.

headline: Gravita India forms Green Maputo Recyclers in Mozambique
summary: Gravita India has incorporated a new entity, Green Maputo Recyclers, in Mozambique to expand its recycling operations in the African market.

headline: FSSAI sends notices to Dr. Reddy's, Nestle, Amazon, Flipkart
summary: FSSAI has issued notices to Dr. Reddy's, Nestle Health Science, Amazon, and Flipkart over claims related to Celevida GLP+, signalling regulatory scrutiny of the product.

headline: Highway Infra wins ₹24.46 crore toll contract from NHAI
summary: Highway Infra has secured a toll operations contract worth ₹24.46 crore from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI).

headline: Anthem BSE block trade: ~30 lakh shares at ₹833
summary: A block trade of approximately 30,00,000 shares of Anthem was executed on BSE at ₹833.00 per share, aggregating to ₹249.90 crore.

headline: Tourism Finance Corporation shares flag large trade
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,117,122 shares of Tourism Finance Corporation of India changing hands on BSE at ₹146.05, with a combined value of ₹30.92 crore.

headline: Cubical Financial Services open offer sees negligible acceptance
summary: Cubical Financial Services Ltd saw only 1,321 shares tendered in its open offer for 26% equity. Acquirers Manoj Agrawal and Amit Kumar Saraogi now hold 68.94% post-offer.

headline: Mirza International sets up footwear subsidiary
summary: Mirza International Limited has incorporated Mirza Global Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand its footwear manufacturing and retail operations.

headline: Sun Pharma shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~96,878 Sun Pharma shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,773.00, with a combined value of ₹17.18 crore.

headline: Kabra family sells 12% stake in Hi-Klass
summary: Krishna Kabra and family members disposed of 37.30 lakh equity shares and warrants in Hi-Klass Trading & Investment Ltd via open market transactions on October 7, 2026.

headline: Rajesh Partani PAC acquires 8.3% in Capricorn Systems
summary: Rajesh Partani and family members acquired 23.20 lakh shares of Capricorn Systems Global Solutions, raising their aggregate holding to 9.14% through open-market purchases on BSE.

headline: Gensol Engineering sees 2.03% stake sale by pledgee
summary: Catalyst Trusteeship sold 7,79,204 Gensol Engineering shares (2.03%) on behalf of lender Power Finance Corporation, reducing pledged holding to 4.64%.

headline: SSPN Finance board to decide name change on Oct 15
summary: SSPN Finance Ltd will hold a board meeting on October 15, 2026, to approve changes to its company name and objects. The board will also amend the Memorandum and Articles of Association.

headline: Capital NxT LLP crosses 5% stake in 3i Infotech
summary: Capital NxT LLP and Persons Acting in Concert acquired 100,000 shares, pushing aggregate holding to 5.02% of total voting capital in 3i Infotech.

headline: Swiggy shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 21,26,406 Swiggy shares changing hands on BSE at ₹237.00, with a combined value of ₹50.40 crore.

headline: AECL revises board outcome on preferential issue
summary: Amalgamated Electricity Company Limited revised its board meeting outcome to remove an erroneous SEBI ICDR regulation reference regarding a ₹650 crore preferential issue.

headline: RMC Switchgears board approves ₹30 crore rights issue
summary: RMC Switchgears Ltd board approved a rights issue of up to ₹30 crore via equity shares. Terms like price and ratio to be decided later.

headline: India 5-year bond yield falls 5 bps to 6.95%
summary: India's 5-year government bond yield declined 5 bps to 6.95%, reflecting a softening in medium-term borrowing costs in the domestic debt market.

headline: Pidilite appoints Amit Agarwal as CFO-designate
summary: Pidilite Industries appointed Amit Agarwal as CFO-designate and Senior Management Personnel effective October 9, 2026, bringing over 22 years of finance experience.

headline: Ashapuri Gold Ornament gets NSE listing approval
summary: Ashapuri Gold Ornament Ltd received in-principle approval from NSE for listing equity shares. Trading begins October 12, 2026, with 33.33 crore shares admitted.

headline: Baazar Style Retail opens new store in West Bengal
summary: Baazar Style Retail Ltd opened a new Style Baazar store in Jalpaiguri, West Bengal, on October 9, 2026. This addition brings the company's total store count to 284.

symbol: ministry of mines, government of india

headline: India mines secretary: no ban decision on black mass exports yet
summary: India's Mines Secretary stated no decision has been made on banning black mass exports, with data collection ongoing. An incentive policy for lithium and nickel processing is expected very soon.

headline: Sandu Pharma director name change
summary: Sandu Pharmaceuticals notified BSE of a name change for Director Dr Neeti Gupta following her marriage. No change in DIN or designation.

headline: Torrent Pharma to host analyst call on Oct 23
summary: Torrent Pharmaceuticals will hold a conference call on October 23, 2026, to discuss Q2FY27 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

headline: AJC Jewel subsidiary opens 4th showroom in Kerala
summary: Esthara Jewels, a subsidiary of AJC Jewel Manufacturers, opened its fourth showroom in Kozhikode on October 8, 2026, focusing on retail silver jewellery sales.

headline: SG Finserve to host Q2FY27 earnings call
summary: SG Finserve Limited will hold a conference call on October 16, 2026, at 5:00 pm IST to discuss Q2FY27 and H1FY27 results with analysts and investors.
